command:
set -eu
master=""
for i in 0 1 2; do
 master=$(redis-cli -h sentinel-$i.sentinel -p 26379 -a "$SENTINEL_PASSWORD" --no-auth-warning --raw SENTINEL get-master-addr-by-name s2t-stress-master 2>/dev/null | head -n 1) || true
 [ -n "$master" ] && break
done
if [ -z "$master" ]; then master=redis-0.redis.s2t-stress-20261005.svc.cluster.local; fi
own="$HOSTNAME.redis.s2t-stress-20261005.svc.cluster.local"
if [ "$master" = "$own" ]; then
 exec redis-server --requirepass "$REDIS_PASSWORD" --masterauth "$REDIS_PASSWORD" --appendonly yes --dir /data --replica-announce-ip "$own" --replica-announce-port 6379
else
 exec redis-server --requirepass "$REDIS_PASSWORD" --masterauth "$REDIS_PASSWORD" --appendonly yes --dir /data --replicaof "$master" 6379 --replica-announce-ip "$own" --replica-announce-port 6379
fi
containers.name: redis

command:
set -eu
if [ ! -f /data/sentinel.conf ]; then
cat > /data/sentinel.conf <<CFG
port 26379
bind 0.0.0.0
protected-mode yes
requirepass $SENTINEL_PASSWORD
sentinel resolve-hostnames yes
sentinel announce-hostnames yes
sentinel announce-ip $HOSTNAME.sentinel.s2t-stress-20261005.svc.cluster.local
sentinel monitor s2t-stress-master redis-0.redis.s2t-stress-20261005.svc.cluster.local 6379 2
sentinel auth-pass s2t-stress-master $REDIS_PASSWORD
sentinel sentinel-pass $SENTINEL_PASSWORD
sentinel down-after-milliseconds s2t-stress-master 2000
sentinel failover-timeout s2t-stress-master 15000
sentinel parallel-syncs s2t-stress-master 1
CFG
fi
sed -i '/^sentinel announce-ip /d; /^sentinel announce-hostnames /d; /^sentinel resolve-hostnames /d' /data/sentinel.conf
printf 'sentinel resolve-hostnames yes\nsentinel announce-hostnames yes\nsentinel announce-ip %s\n' "$HOSTNAME.sentinel.s2t-stress-20261005.svc.cluster.local" >> /data/sentinel.conf
exec redis-server /data/sentinel.conf --sentinel
containers.name: sentinel
